entities.summary: The Zarrabi Mosque is a former mosque and architectural monument located in the city of Ganja, Azerbaijan. The mosque was built in the 19th century and was included in the list of immovable historical and cultural monuments of local significance by the decree No. 132 issued by the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Azerbaijan on 2 August 2001.
